### Summary

`dio_http2_adapter` follows HTTP `Location` redirects without stripping sensitive request headers when the redirect target is a different origin. An attacker who can cause any origin server to return a cross-origin `302` redirect receives the victim's `Authorization`, `Cookie`, and `Proxy-Authorization` headers verbatim. articles.title: GHSA: Nginx UI: Auto backup name allows path traversal outside validated storage path
articles.summary:
## Summary

Nginx UI validates `backup_path` and `storage_path` against the administrator-defined `backup.GrantedAccessPath` boundary, but the final auto-backup output filename is built from the user-controlled auto-backup `name` without stripping path separators or `..` components.

An authenticated user who can create or modify an auto-backup task can set a name such as `task/../../../escaped`.
